card.name: Go and Went inside names
card.fires_on: The word piece "go" or "went" (Go, ogo, Went, go) when it sits inside a proper name or title, such as Gogo-Yimidjir, Read2Go, Wentworth, Go Fish. It also fires on plain "went" or "go" as a verb.

modes.label: Went- in surnames
modes.description: "Went" begins the surname Wentworth after a first name.

modes.label: Plain verb go/went
modes.description: The verb "went" or "go" appears after a plural subject, as in prints went on or jobs go overseas.
